triggers.name: filesystem_file_modified
triggers.description: A filesystem event watcher plugin that monitors a directory and fires whenever existing files are updated to trigger an automated one-time skill with modified file details. Use when file edits, data refreshes, or configuration updates require instant automated reaction. Use this to keep downstream workflows continuously synchronized with file modifications without active polling.

spec.name: filesystem_file_modified
spec.description: A filesystem event watcher plugin that monitors a directory and fires whenever existing files are updated to trigger an automated one-time skill with modified file details. Use when file edits, data refreshes, or configuration updates require instant automated reaction. Use this to keep downstream workflows continuously synchronized with file modifications without active polling.

watch_path.description: Directory to watch for modified files

pattern.description: File pattern to match, e.g. *.txt. Default *.*

triggers.name: filesystem_new_file
triggers.description: A filesystem event watcher plugin that monitors a specified directory and fires upon new file creation to pass new file paths into an automated one-time skill. Use when incoming files (such as new images, logs, or reports) require instant automated processing upon arrival. Use this to react immediately to incoming file data without polling delays or manual checks.

spec.name: filesystem_new_file
spec.description: A filesystem event watcher plugin that monitors a specified directory and fires upon new file creation to pass new file paths into an automated one-time skill. Use when incoming files (such as new images, logs, or reports) require instant automated processing upon arrival. Use this to react immediately to incoming file data without polling delays or manual checks.

watch_path.description: Directory to watch for new files, e.g. storage/files/watch

pattern.description: File pattern to match, e.g. *.txt, *.csv. Default *.*

triggers.name: manage_triggers
triggers.description: List, start, update, or stop page-monitor triggers. Each trigger watches its own hidden tab on its own cadence while you work; it fires once and dies. list shows every running trigger; update edits one.

spec.name: manage_triggers
spec.description: List, start, update, or stop page-monitor triggers. Each trigger watches its own hidden tab on its own cadence while you work; it fires once and dies. list shows every running trigger; update edits one.

url.description: http(s) site to watch (required with start).
